markdown_content: # Avatar IK Joint Mapping | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive This document explains the process of importing 3D avatars with joints into Clo 2025.0 and setting up IK (Inverse Kinematics) joints for easier editing, posing, and animation. It includes instructions for verifying joints, using the avatar editor, setting T-poses, auto-mapping joints, editing IK joints, and applying poses or motion files. --- ## Importing Avatars with Joints for IK Setup This section covers the prerequisites and initial steps for bringing 3D avatars into Clo, emphasizing the importance of having pre-existing joints in the FBX file to enable IK joint addition. - Import your 3D avatar by dragging and dropping an FBX file. - The FBX must already contain joints; these are necessary to add IK joints (represented as green dots). - IK joints improve ease of editing, adjusting, posing, and animating the avatar. - For best results, use avatars with existing joint structures (e.g., Elite models). - In the import options, enable: - Open Avatar - Auto Scale - Joint Animation - Fitting suits are optional but not required for this process. - Align the avatar’s bottom before importing to ensure proper positioning. --- ## Accessing and Displaying Joints This section explains how to verify and toggle the visibility of joints within Clo to prepare for IK joint editing. - After import, verify that joints exist by toggling joint visibility. - Use the shortcut key or navigate through the 3D toggle menu: - Go to **Avatar Display** - Enable **Show Joints** or **Show Avatar Joints** - Make sure joints are visible before proceeding to IK joint editing. --- ## Using the Avatar Editor to Set Up IK Joints This section guides through opening the Avatar Editor, setting the T-pose, and understanding the interface related to IK joint mapping. - Open the Avatar Editor via the top toolbar: **Avatar > Avatar Editor**. - The default view may show "Avatar Size"; navigate to the **IK Joint** tab. - The first critical step is to set the avatar’s T-pose: - Click **Set T Pose** to establish the base pose. - If the pose is accidentally changed, use **Reset** to revert to the T-pose. - Setting the T-pose is essential because Clo uses this as a reference to apply other poses and animations correctly. - The Avatar Editor interface includes: - Shadow avatar showing joint locations - Buttons for auto mapping, resetting mapping, opening saved mappings, and saving current mappings - An info icon linking to the manual for detailed help --- ## Manual and Auto Mapping of IK Joints This section details how to map joints manually or automatically and save mappings for reuse. - The mapping screen displays required and optional joint points; required points must be assigned for IK functionality. - Manual mapping process: - Click a joint label (e.g., Head, Waist). - A bright white dot on the shadow avatar indicates where to place the joint on the imported model. - Assign joints one by one by clicking the corresponding points on your avatar. - Auto mapping: - Use the **Auto Mapping** button to have Clo automatically assign joint points. - Auto mapping is efficient and accurate for standard avatars. - After mapping, click **Set T Bones** to finalize the bone structure. - Save your mapping for future use or to share with others via the **Save Mapping** option. - You can also load previously saved mappings using **Open Mapping**. --- ## Editing IK Joints and Applying Poses This section explains how to fine-tune IK joints, utilize symmetry for adjustments, and apply poses or motion files to the avatar. - Access the IK joints editor to adjust joint positions for better fit or animation control. - Symmetry mode helps make uniform adjustments across mirrored joints (e.g., left and right arms). - You can import and apply poses from the pose library to instantly change the avatar’s stance. - Additionally, motion files (animation data) can be imported via the Animation Editor: - Load a motion file to preview and apply animations on the avatar. - This allows for dynamic movement and realistic posing. --- # Summary Clo 2025.0 enhances avatar rigging by enabling IK joint addition to FBX models with existing joints. Proper T-pose setting, manual or auto mapping, and IK joint editing facilitate easier avatar posing and animation. The system supports saving mappings, using symmetry tools, and importing motion files to streamline 3D avatar workflows.
